prompt: The goldfish (to swim) around happily if it (to live) in a bigger tank.
explanation_ru: Рыбка сейчас живёт не в большом аквариуме, поэтому условие нереальное: в главной части — would + глагол, в части с if — Past Simple.

prompt: Maren (to feel) much better if the sun (to come) back to her town.
explanation_ru: Солнце сейчас не вернулось, это лишь мечта: в главной части — would + глагол, после if — Past Simple.

prompt: Tomek (to smile) again if his tent (not / to be) wet.
explanation_ru: Палатка мокрая, поэтому это нереальное условие: после if допустимы и were, и was (для he/she/it), а в главной части — would.

prompt: If Ananya (to find) more space, she (to plant) flowers on the roof.
explanation_ru: Места на крыше сейчас нет, это воображаемая ситуация: после if — Past Simple, в главной части — would + глагол.

prompt: Could Einar (to climb) the wall each break if the school (to build) one?
explanation_ru: Это вопрос о нереальной возможности: после could идёт инфинитив без to, а в части с if — Past Simple.

prompt: If the trams (not / to rattle) my window, I (to sleep) through the night.
explanation_ru: Трамваи гремят сейчас, поэтому условие нереальное: отрицание в Past Simple — did not rattle, в главной части — would + глагол.

prompt: If I (to have) the office dog's easy day, I (to nap) through the boring meeting.
explanation_ru: Я сейчас не на месте собаки, это воображаемая ситуация: после if — Past Simple (had), в главной части — would + глагол.

prompt: Dario (to arrive) before his lectures if the clocks (to run) backwards.
explanation_ru: Часы не идут назад, это фантазия: после if — Past Simple (ran), в главной части — would + глагол.

prompt: Weronika (to leave) the car and walk if the jam (to last) much longer.
explanation_ru: Пробка ещё не стала слишком долгой, это маловероятное предположение: после if — Past Simple, в главной части — would + глагол.

prompt: If my meetings (to end) at lunch, I (to reach) home early.
explanation_ru: Собрания на самом деле идут до вечера, это несбыточное условие: после if — Past Simple, в главной части — would + глагол.

prompt: If Marta (to paint) a tiny blue bird in the corner, the huge empty canvas (not / to feel) so bare.
explanation_ru: Птицы на холсте нет, это воображаемый замысел: после if — Past Simple, а в главной части отрицание строится как would not + глагол.

prompt: Your puppy is not too bad. If I (to be) you, I (to keep) him quiet and indoors. Rest is what the paw needs. It would heal much faster if you (to give) it that rest.
explanation_ru: Совет «на вашем месте» всегда идёт с were (If I were you), после него — would; в части с if о собаке — Past Simple.

prompt: I stood right behind a tall fan at the show. If he (to sit) in a seat, I (to see) the stage easily. Instead I watched the screen the whole time. The music itself was great.
explanation_ru: Высокий болельщик стоял, а не сидел, поэтому условие нереальное: после if — Past Simple (sat), в главной части — would + глагол.

prompt: I ordered shoes and got the wrong size twice. If the shop (to check) the box, I (to keep) them. The return form is hard to fill on my phone.

prompt: The app cuts out again and again. If it (to work) properly, I (not / to miss) a word. The sound drops at the worst moment.
explanation_ru: Приложение сейчас работает плохо, это нереальное условие: после if — Past Simple, отрицание в главной части — would not + глагол.

prompt: The floodlights turn off early. If they (to stay) on, I (not / to lose) the ball. The team often trains in the dark.
explanation_ru: Свет сейчас выключается, поэтому условие нереальное: после if — Past Simple, в главной части — would not + глагол.

prompt: The order machine breaks in the Friday rush again and again. If it (not / to crash) at the busiest hour, the kitchen (to manage) the orders and Enzo (to serve) each table on time.
explanation_ru: Машина на самом деле ломается, это нереальное условие: после if — Past Simple, обе части результата — would + глагол.

prompt: If Zuzanna ___ on a warm beach, she would feel much better.
options: relaxes
will relax
relaxed
would relax
explanation_ru: После if в нереальном условии идёт Past Simple (relaxed), а не настоящее или will/would — это типичная ошибка «если бы».

prompt: If Oksana ___ a quiet train, she would take it through the green hills.
options: finds
found
will find
would find
explanation_ru: Нереальное условие требует Past Simple после if (found); finds, will find и would find — типичные ошибки «если бы».

prompt: If Sami ___ his cards right away, nobody would steal his money.
options: would cancel
will cancel
cancels
cancelled
explanation_ru: После if нельзя ставить would — в нереальном условии нужен Past Simple (cancelled); «if + would» — частая ошибка «если бы».

prompt: If Bora ___ earlier, he would still get a good seat for the comedy.
options: arrives
arrived
will arrive
would arrive
explanation_ru: После if в нереальном условии — Past Simple (arrived), а не настоящее или will/would.

prompt: If Carlos ___ to arrive before the recruiter, he would hand in his CV in person.
options: were
was
is
would
explanation_ru: Конструкция «If he were to arrive» передаёт маловероятное будущее: после if нужен were, а не was, is или would.

prompt: My cake would not melt in the warm hall if it would arrive on time.
answer: My cake would not melt in the warm hall if it arrived on time.
accepted_answers: My cake would not melt in the warm hall if it arrived on time.
My cake wouldn't melt in the warm hall if it arrived on time.

prompt: If Nuria's appointment were not moved again, she would be less annoyed.
answer: If Nuria's appointment were not moved again, she would be less annoyed.
accepted_answers: If Nuria's appointment were not moved again, she would be less annoyed.
If Nuria's appointment was not moved again, she would be less annoyed.
If Nuria's appointment weren't moved again, she would be less annoyed.
If Nuria's appointment wasn't moved again, she would be less annoyed.

prompt: I would label my milk if the hostel will give out labels.
answer: I would label my milk if the hostel gave out labels.
accepted_answers: I would label my milk if the hostel gave out labels.
explanation_ru: После if в нереальном условии нельзя ставить will — нужен Past Simple: gave out.

prompt: Klara would finish the reports in an hour if her desk is quiet.
answer: Klara would finish the reports in an hour if her desk were quiet.
accepted_answers: Klara would finish the reports in an hour if her desk were quiet.
Klara would finish the reports in an hour if her desk was quiet.
explanation_ru: После if в нереальном условии нужен Past Simple, а не настоящее время: is → were/was.

prompt: Deniz's cousin is moving to a new flat and has no savings. Deniz gives her advice.
options: If I were you, I would save a little money each month.
If I were you, I would have saved a little money each month.
If I am you, I will save a little money each month.
If I was you, I save a little money each month.
explanation_ru: Совет «на вашем месте» передаётся как If I were you + would; «would have saved» — про прошлое, а am/was и will — неверные формы.

prompt: Aylin wants a restful week and cannot choose between two islands. The travel agent gives advice.
options: If I am you, I will pick the quieter island.
If I were you, I would pick the quieter island.
If I were you, I picked the quieter island.
If I were you, I would have picked the quieter island.
explanation_ru: Совет «на вашем месте» — If I were you + would; остальные варианты ломают форму (am/will, без would, would have — про прошлое).

prompt: The hillside is dry, so Carmen cannot plant anything. → If the hillside were not so dry,
answer: If the hillside were not so dry, Carmen could plant something.
accepted_answers: If the hillside were not so dry, Carmen could plant something.
If the hillside was not so dry, Carmen could plant something.
If the hillside weren't so dry, Carmen could plant something.
If the hillside wasn't so dry, Carmen could plant something.
explanation_ru: Из «cannot plant» (невозможность) получаем could plant, а в части с if — Past Simple: were not / was not so dry.

prompt: Camille has no money for a big graduation party in Paris. → If Camille had enough money,
answer: If Camille had enough money, she would plan a big graduation party in Paris.
accepted_answers: If Camille had enough money, she would plan a big graduation party in Paris.
If Camille had enough money, she'd plan a big graduation party in Paris.
explanation_ru: Нереальное условие: в части с if — Past Simple (had), в главной части — would + глагол (plan).

prompt: The car park blocks the way, so Gareth cannot show his pupils the plain where the stones stand. → If the car park were not there,
answer: If the car park were not there, Gareth would show his pupils the plain where the stones stand.
accepted_answers: If the car park were not there, Gareth would show his pupils the plain where the stones stand.
If the car park was not there, Gareth would show his pupils the plain where the stones stand.
If the car park weren't there, Gareth would show his pupils the plain where the stones stand.
If the car park wasn't there, Gareth would show his pupils the plain where the stones stand.
explanation_ru: Нереальное условие: после if — Past Simple (were not / was not there), в главной части — would + глагол; придаточное where the stones stand остаётся без изменений.

prompt: Ivana would enjoy the visit if the dentist's drill were a tiny violin.
options: The drill is a violin, so Ivana enjoys the visit.
The drill was not a violin, so Ivana did not enjoy the visit.
The drill is not a violin, so Ivana does not enjoy the visit.
The drill is not a violin, but Ivana enjoys the visit.
explanation_ru: Условие нереальное (бормашина — не скрипка), поэтому в реальности всё наоборот и в настоящем времени: does not enjoy.

prompt: If Anouk made her short film, a talking cat would star in it.

Anouk does not make the film, so a talking cat does not star in it.
Anouk did not make the film, so a talking cat did not star in it.
Anouk does not make the film, but a talking cat stars in it.
explanation_ru: Фильм не снимается (условие нереальное), значит в реальности кота в нём нет — в настоящем времени.

prompt: If Kirill's street were a green pedestrian lane, cars would stay away.
options: The street is a green lane, so cars stay away.
The street was not a green lane, so cars did not stay away.
The street is not a green lane, so cars do not stay away.
The street is not a green lane, but cars stay away.
explanation_ru: Улица не стала пешеходной (условие нереальное), поэтому машины на самом деле не уезжают — в настоящем времени.

prompt: Match the halves about the shared kitchen.
pairs: I would wash the pan first.
Eilidh could start cooking at once.
she would lend him the pan.
explanation_ru: Каждая левая часть — нереальное условие (were, Past Simple), и к ней подходит результат с would/could по смыслу и форме.

prompt: Join the halves about Marcus's diner.
pairs: If the diner became a jazz café,
it would draw a late-night crowd.
If Marcus finds a good pianist,
he could host live music inside.
explanation_ru: Нереальные условия (became, were) требуют would/could, а реальные планы на будущее (finds, agrees) — will/can.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: Were Hiro to buy a print, he would choose a small one.
accepted_answers: Were Hiro to buy a print, he would choose a small one.
explanation_ru: Это инверсия от «If Hiro were to buy»: Were + подлежащее + to buy, в главной части — would + глагол.

prompt: Which world is each sentence about?

items.text: If I were you, I would practise reading aloud.
If the bell rings, we will stop reading.
If Sakura had more time, she would help each pupil.
If you read the text, you will understand it.
If the lesson were shorter, we would read in pairs.
If Sakura asks, I will read it aloud.

explanation_ru: «If I were / were shorter / had more time» — нереальное настоящее; «if the bell rings / you read / Sakura asks» — реальное возможное будущее.
